submission.justification: Radiator-R3 at 3 cm thickness provides the best pion/kaon separation performance among all viable candidates. It achieves 4.029 sigma separation at 10 GeV/c, which represents a 38.7% improvement over the alternative Radiator-R2 (2.905 sigma at its optimal 3 cm thickness). Although Radiator-R1 showed slightly better separation (4.6 sigma at 3 cm), it fails the critical humidity ageing test and must be excluded as it cannot be replaced during the 10-year run. Radiator-R3 passes the ageing test with transparency loss within the required 10% limit, and 3 cm falls well within the allowed thickness range of 1-6 cm. The thickness of 3 cm represents the optimal point where R3 achieves maximum separation performance.
